certainty_audit.limitations: This audit quantifies modal/default ceilings and certainty-dropped benchmark loss. It does not yet implement annotation-guideline certainty rules over evidence-correct rows, so it supports demoting certainty as a likely projection layer but not a completed guideline-rule projection claim.
certainty_audit.note: SeizureFrequency already ignores Certainty/Negation in its benchmark key (guideline convention), so it contributes no certainty-only loss.

architectures.clinical_recovery_note: Primary clinical-recovery headline is CUI-free and aggregates only the five essential families. A CUI-projected companion score is reported separately because the legacy SeizureFrequency state key uses CUI as seizure-type identity when present.
